title: CobbleCraft S6
description: The official modpack for Season 6 of the CobbleCraft SMP! Enjoy vanilla enhancements, paired with loads of QOL mods complete the CobbleCraft expierience.
body:
This is the OFFCIAL CobbleCraft S6 Modpack!

**All credits are due to the respective developers of ALL mods in this modpack.**

![CobbleCraft Network Lobby <3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e02f595b186fdf8c1a8b05db3c38b0b913526090_0.webp)

This modpack aims to enhance the original vanilla minecraft we all know and love, with more vanilla-like biomes, lots of QOL additions, and a much more refined multiplayer experience!

This modpack includes the likes of,

Terralith ⛰️

![Beautiful Terrain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/18f528fe047ae646f560c73112d0010cc0301ebc_0.webp)

Regions Unexplored 🌴

![Regions Unexplored is AMAZING!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a6ddfb4bf96bce10850b972befcd84d78978cf8_0.webp)

Farmer's Delight 🍎

![Chef KarimMC cookin' up!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/373acdb155b2ba8be7745e613dea1e067764479d_0.webp)

And much more! 🌟

![Small Overworld Structure!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a122fb28052e2abfb625c7d559f129e7967b2e73_0.webp)

**All credits are due to the respective developers of ALL mods in this modpack.**
